sourceFirstFindings.finding: Blanket hormone/HER2-drugs-do-not-apply and lacks-targets wording needs testing/indication-specific qualification; do not inherit absolute absence or no-options inference.
Universal stage-II/III sequencing language needs the actual high-risk study/label eligibility and clinical context, with no individual treatment mandate.
The regimen trial measures a full perioperative comparison, not independent causal contributions of a phase or drug. Pathology response is a separate observation.
The universal statement that no trial compared blood-result-based surgery omission needs a defined current search or a qualified reading-rule replacement; no universal absence claim is adopted.
Keep first-602 pCR and all-1174 survival populations, clocks and estimated probabilities separate. The approximate five-point interpretation is not an individual forecast or literal raw count.
One personal-application section per pin is excluded from teaching. Its source identity is retained privately; no personal details enter the assessment.

The original immune-route section has additional steps and alternative recognition details. Preserve them separately and assess its always/main-kind wording rather than importing a universal route or unsourced frequency claim.

dispositions.SH-SF01: Qualified in existing receptor/ADC and updated timing/residual text.
dispositions.SH-SF02: Selected trial/label population and schedule arithmetic, not a universal stage-based instruction.
dispositions.SH-SF03: Full-regimen comparison does not isolate phases or convert pCR to survival.
dispositions.SH-SF04: Universal no-trial assertion replaced by the bounded assay-versus-decision-validation inference.
dispositions.SH-SF05: Both denominators, endpoints, time window, estimates and rounded differences explicit.
dispositions.SH-SF06: Personal application excluded at both source pins; no personal content copied.
dispositions.SH-SF07: Both original-only recognition obligations retained with route/subset scope.
